group.title: Investigating a label mismatch
group.passage:
Man: The shipping box labels show the letter R, then the number eight. The units inside show the letter R, then the number nine. I have stopped the shipment.
Woman: Keep the boxes in the marked holding area. Compare the labels with the packing list.
Man: The list is correct. The label printer may have used an old template.
Woman: Let’s check the print history. Do not relabel anything until the quality team approves the correction.
group.passageZh:
男：出貨紙箱上的標籤先顯示字母 R，再顯示數字 8。箱內產品的標示則是字母 R，接著是數字 9。我已停止出貨。
女：把紙箱留在有標示的暫存區。請比對標籤與裝箱單。
男：裝箱單沒錯。印表機可能用了舊版標籤樣板。
女：先查列印紀錄。品管部門核准更正之前，不要重貼任何標籤。
